name: rr-implement
description: Helps the user implement a feature. TRIGGER when: the user asks to add, build, create, make, or implement something (new feature, new system, new command, new API, new behaviour); the user asks to implement functionality described in a requirements file. SKIP: the user is asking to fix a bug in existing code; the user is asking to refactor or rename existing code without changing behaviour; the user is explicitly asking only to plan or design (those go to rr-plan instead).
